verdict.rationale: Cua mainly hosts external agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) inside Spaces or drives apps for them, rather than shipping its own assistant. Two items point to a first-party agent layer. Docs describe a persistent "named agent" with memory, daemon-fired routines, notifications and pause/resume. A hands-on report shows a cua-agent Gradio UI that took a task, though it typed in the wrong place and later runs failed to connect. missing for 10: clear first-party documentation of a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to in the product UI, evidence of reliable task completion, and independent corroboration of current versions.
